name: Malmaison Brighton
accommodation: 73 bedrooms from standard doubles and twins to sea-view club rooms and a signature suite
suitableFor: Couples and groups wanting free parking and a waterfront base east of the centre
parking: Free parking on request when booking direct; Marina car park next door
dogs: Accepted by arrangement in bedrooms, bar and terrace (Visit Brighton listing)
beachAccess: On the Marina waterfront; Visit Brighton says the coast is about five minutes' walk, about 2 miles from Palace Pier
confirmedFeatures: Brasserie and bar, terrace, air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, 24-hour reception, sea-view rooms, lift
overview: Malmaison sits on the waterfront at Brighton Marina, about two miles east of Palace Pier. It has 73 rooms, several of them sea-view club rooms, with a brasserie and bar on the ground floor and a reception that is staffed around the clock. Parking is free on request for guests who book direct, which is unusual in Brighton.
surfTripFit: Free parking avoids Brighton's parking costs, and the Marina is the eastern end of the seafront if you want to get away from the busier central beaches.
